newsitem.title: CHINA: China northeast oilfields to produce 74 mln T.
newsitem.headline: China northeast oilfields to produce 74 mln T.

text.p: China's northeastern oilfields planned to produce 74 million tonnes of crude oil a year by the year 2000, the Xinhua news agency said on Friday.
The fields produced 74.93 million tonnes of crude oil last year, or half of China's total output, it quoted Zhang Hong, deputy general manager of the China Oil and Gas Corporation, as saying.
The big Daqing field alone produced 56 million tonnes of crude in 1995, Xinhua said.
In the 1996-2000 ninth five-year plan, the northeastern fields were expected to earn 86.3 billion yuan from sales of oil and gas, Xinhua said.

Geologists have discovered 7.686 billion tonnes of proven oil reserves in the northeast, accounting for 44.1 percent of the total oil potential in China, along with 106.84 billion cu metres of natural gas reserves, or 7.6 percent of the nation's total, it added.
